comment: TrpB installs three crosslinks on the precursor peptide, generating highly constrained atropopeptide scaffold

reactions.description: P450 monooxygenase, TrpB is responsible for the atropospecific formation of one carbon-carbon and two carbon-nitrogen bonds
TrpB installs three crosslinks on the precursor peptide followed by protease activity to generate the highly constrained  hexa- and pentapeptide products Tryptorubin A (AWYIWY) and B (WYIWY).
